title: Verify: BootScene NPC spawn and characterClick unit tests
summary: Unit tests with Phaser mocked for multi-NPC spawn and click events.
description: Extend the Phaser-mocked character suite with a second NPC that has an interaction.
acceptance_criteria: Two sprites spawn at their positions and idle.
characterClick emitted only for NPCs with interaction.
technical_constraints: Reuse the existing vi.mock('phaser') and vi.mock content fixtures; no real Phaser

steps.action: Append a second character to scene.characters: id 'shopkeeper', position {x:60,y:120}, scale 1, layer 'characters', animations.idle reusing {asset:'character:boy',animation:'idle'}, interaction {dialogue:'greet',events:[]}; add {id:'shopkeeper',name:'Shopkeeper'} to world.characters.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts -t 'spawns one sprite'
steps.expected: Fixture has a boy without interaction and an NPC with interaction.

steps.symbol: new: it('spawns one sprite per scene character')
steps.action: Create BootScene, call create(), assert add.sprite was called twice with first two args (150,140) and (60,120), and play was called on both sprites.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts -t 'spawns one sprite'

steps.symbol: new: it('emits characterClick only for NPCs with interaction')
steps.action: Subscribe with phaserToReact.on('characterClick', spy). Using pointerDownOn(sprite) invoke the shopkeeper listener and assert spy called once with {id:'shopkeeper',dialogue:'greet'}; invoke the boy listener and assert spy still called once.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts -t 'emits characterClick'
